'''X1-02''' was the designation of a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It relayed to Imperial forces a transmission from [[Darth Malgus]].

==Behind the scenes==
X1-02 can be found both on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
